question: Which figures are enumerated among the eight Bhairavas?
premises: They are part of the eight Bhairavas.
inference: Kapālī, Bhīṣaṇa, Saṃhāra, and others constitute the eight Bhairavas.
uncertainties: only three names are listed in this verse; the full set is implied
plain_english: Kapālī, Bhīṣaṇa, and Saṃhāra are among the eight Bhairavas.
